summary: Adopt Goals wiki page convention into PLATE template payload and bootstrap (Epic #218 / Feature #224)

entries.migration_impact: New adopters via bootstrap or template now receive the recommended lightweight Goals wiki page convention (Mission, Core Principles, How We Intend to Succeed, etc.). Existing projects can manually add docs/wiki/Goals.md following the structure in the shipped convention doc.
entries.agent_notes: Information Audit agents (Epic #218) will now expect and read a Goals page when present as a primary strategic signal. The convention doc itself is in the payload under docs/design/. Use it when generating or refining Questions against project mission.
